description: PHP class for generating array representations of 2D barcodes for use with TCPDF, including a test barcode implementation.

classes.name: TCPDF2DBarcode
classes.description: A class that creates array representations of 2D barcodes, with a constructor for setting barcode data and methods to retrieve or set the barcode array.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the barcode object with code and type, calling setBarcode.

methods.name: getBarcodeArray
methods.description: Returns the array representation of the barcode.

methods.name: setBarcode
methods.description: Sets the barcode array based on the provided code and type, with a test mode implementation.
